resources.string: Keep this page offline and apart from your phone. It tells you how to get back into LocalGateKeys if you forget the app password.
App password (write it by hand, or keep it apart from this page):
On the LocalGateKeys lock screen, tap “%1$s”.
Type the %1$d words above, in order.
Choose a new app password. Your passwords are not changed.
If the phone is lost or the vault is gone, install LocalGateKeys on a new phone, then restore your latest backup file or sync from your PC or another phone.
Treat this page like your vault. A PDF saved with the recovery phrase on it is as sensitive as the vault itself: keep the paper somewhere safe and delete any saved PDF when you are done.
Print emergency kit with this phrase
